search_text: published ZDI-21-268 ZDI-CAN-11708 (0Day) Lepide Active Directory Self Service Unsafe Interaction Authentication Bypass Vulnerability 2021-03-11 9.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Lepide'] ['Active Directory Self Service'] This vulnerability allows physical or remote attackers to bypass the Windows login screen on affected installations of Lepide Active Directory Self Service. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the "Reset Password / Unlock Account" feature. By interacting with this feature, an attacker can launch a highly-privileged web browser. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass the Windows login screen and execute code in the context of SYSTEM.
